subjects.label: Against the first game
subjects.description: Weighing this sequel against its predecessor: what it kept, what it fixed, what it lost and whether it is the better game; comparisons to other games in the genre belong in genre.

subjects.label: Movement and traversal
subjects.description: The feel of moving through the world with the chain of jumps, dashes, glides and grapples that lets the character fly across the map; which abilities exist and how they combine belongs in the ability kit row.

subjects.label: Ability kit and builds
subjects.description: The abilities and upgrades you unlock, whether each one earns its place, and the shard or rune combinations that make different builds; the raw feel of running and jumping belongs in movement and traversal.

subjects.label: Boss fights and escape sequences
subjects.description: The set-piece encounters: the named bosses, their hitboxes and attacks, and the scripted chase or escape sequences that spike the pulse; ordinary combat against small enemies belongs in gameplay.

subjects.label: Thorns and terrain hazards
subjects.description: Dying to the environment rather than to enemies: thorns and spikes, darkness that kills on contact and other instant-death terrain; the overall difficulty curve belongs in difficulty.

subjects.label: Crying at it
subjects.description: Being moved to tears or grief by the game, its final theme or the memories it stirs, including comparisons to other tearjerkers; praise of the story that does not speak of being moved belongs in story.

subjects.label: The ending and the villain
subjects.description: The climax of the story: the antagonist as a creature rejected from birth, the sacrifice and transformation at the end, and the cycle it closes; the companion creatures have their own row.

subjects.label: The forest folk
subjects.description: The companion creatures and side characters, the little villagers and the rabbit-dog players find adorable or wish had more to do; the villain and the ending belong in their own row.

subjects.label: Full collection
subjects.description: Hunting down every collectible and upgrade for a complete run, how long that takes and how hard it is; how long the main path lasts belongs in content.
